name: behavior

Work only in the fresh disposable fixture checkout at its immutable seed. Keep changes within the listed ownership. Add focused regression tests. Do not install dependencies, change model settings, call APIs, start services, execute database or provider commands, access credentials, commit, push, open a PR, or use earlier trial outputs.
